description: Dex Agents CLI configuration behavior every CLI runtime must match: YAML parsing, schema validation, file defaults, the media store, session override narrowing, operation names, and the shell allow list. Hand-written; see README.md and agents/cli/README.md.

error_codes.yaml: The file is not one YAML 1.2 document with unique keys. path is always "".
error_codes.schema: The value fails the schema. Runtimes may report schema errors in any order. Each schema case has exactly one violation, and a runtime passes it when validation fails and the expected instance location path and keyword are among its validator's errors, nested anyOf errors included.
error_codes.invalid_url: dex.server, connectors.mcp, or media.endpoint passes the schema but is not a URL a WHATWG URL parser accepts with a port of at most 65535: an IPv4 part that is not 0 or a decimal from 1 to 255 without a leading zero, an invalid IPv6 address, a DNS label starting with xn--, or a port over 65535. path is the field.
error_codes.duplicate_tool: One entry names the same operation twice, in two spellings. path is the entry.
error_codes.duplicate_connection: Two entries cover the same connection. path is the later entry.
error_codes.model_required: Neither the file nor the harness command gives a model.
error_codes.widens_connectors: A session entry is not inside any entry of the file. path is the entry.
error_codes.widens_local_tools: A session switches on what the file switches off, or allows a command the file does not.

warnings: Resolving session settings also returns warnings: the JSON Pointer of every top-level key the session settings schema does not define, sorted by key in Unicode code point order. Those keys are ignored. Settings that fail resolution report no warnings. A TypeScript runtime must compare code points: the default Array sort compares UTF-16 code units and puts U+10000 before U+E000.
check_order: Report the first failure in this order: yaml; schema; invalid_url for dex.server, then connectors.mcp, then media.endpoint; then connector entries in list order, each checked for duplicate_tool, duplicate_connection against earlier entries, and (sessions only) widens_connectors; then model_required; then local_tools in the order files, shell.enabled, shell.allow by index, web_fetch, browser.
